# University Magazine

> A comprehensive Canadian education resource providing career guidance, financial aid tools, university rankings, and student lifestyle advice.

University Magazine serves students and graduates across Canada with practical tools like GPA calculators and loan estimators, alongside editorial content on scholarships, career salaries, travel, and academic planning. The site covers university rankings, program comparisons, and major selection guidance for Canadian and international institutions.

## Key Topics

- Financial Aid
- Scholarships
- University Rankings
- College Majors
- GPA Calculator
- Career Advice
- Canada Education
- Nursing Programs
- Student Life
- Cost of Living
- Academic Planning
- University Comparison
- Student Travel
- Salary Guides
- Career Planning

## Financial Aid & Planning Tools

- [GPA Calculator | Calculate Your Final Exam Grade](https://www.universitymagazine.ca/gpa-calculator): Free GPA calculator tool for computing final exam grades and academic planning.
- [Canada Student Loan Estimator 2026 | Calculate Grants and Loans](https://www.universitymagazine.ca/student-aid-estimator): Canada student loan calculator estimating grants and loans for 2026 academic year.
- [Top College Scholarships 2024](https://www.universitymagazine.ca/college-scholarships): Comprehensive scholarship database with 2024 listings and financial aid search tools.

## University Rankings & Program Guides

- [The Best University for Nursing in Canada 2026](https://www.universitymagazine.ca/best-university-for-nursing-in-canada-2026): 2026 ranking of top Canadian nursing programs led by University of Toronto.
- [The Best Universities in Alberta for Nursing 2026](https://www.universitymagazine.ca/best-universities-in-alberta-for-nursing): Ranking of Alberta nursing programs at University of Alberta and Calgary.
- [The Best Kinesiology Schools In Canada 2026](https://www.universitymagazine.ca/the-best-kinesiology-schools-in-canada): 2026 ranking of Canadian kinesiology schools including Université de Montréal.
- [The best Universities in Egypt 2023](https://www.universitymagazine.ca/the-best-universities-in-egypt): Ranking of top Egyptian universities including Helwan University in Cairo.

## Academic Guidance & Major Selection

- [How to Change Your University Major Without Delaying Graduation](https://www.universitymagazine.ca/how-to-change-your-university-major-without-delaying-graduation): Guide on switching university majors while maintaining graduation timeline.
- [College Majors With the Lowest Unemployment 2025](https://www.universitymagazine.ca/college-majors-with-the-lowest-unemployment): 2025 analysis of college majors with lowest unemployment rates and job security.

## Career & Salary Information

- [Is $100,000 a Good Salary in Canada in 2026? The Honest Answer](https://www.universitymagazine.ca/is-100000-a-good-salary-in-canada-in-2026): Analysis of six-figure salary purchasing power across Toronto, Calgary, Halifax.
- [Average Salary in Tennessee 2026: Nashville, Memphis and Knoxville Pay Guide](https://www.universitymagazine.ca/average-salary-in-tennessee): 2026 salary data for Tennessee cities including Nashville, Memphis, and Knoxville.
- [Average Salary in Minnesota 2026: Minneapolis, Saint Paul and Beyond](https://www.universitymagazine.ca/average-salary-in-minnesot): 2026 Minnesota salary comparison across Minneapolis, Saint Paul, and Twin Cities.
- [Average Salary in Georgia 2026: Atlanta Pay Guide](https://www.universitymagazine.ca/average-salary-in-georgia): 2026 Georgia salary guide covering Atlanta fintech, Delta, and corporate wages.

## Student Travel & Lifestyle

- [March 2026 Travel Alert: War Closes Airspace | Thousands of Students Stranded](https://www.universitymagazine.ca/march-2026-student-travel-emergency-alerts): Breaking news on Middle East crisis affecting international student travel and flights.
- [Best Student Flight Discounts Canada 2026: Book Reading Week](https://www.universitymagazine.ca/best-student-flight-discounts-canada): Guide to 2026 student flight discounts with Air Canada and Porter Airlines deals.
- [Easiest Working Holiday Visas for Canadian Graduates in 2026](https://www.universitymagazine.ca/easiest-working-holiday-visas-for-canadian-graduates): Guide to working holiday visas for Canadian graduates including UK Youth Mobility.
- [Top College Student March Break Ideas for 2026](https://www.universitymagazine.ca/college-student-march-break-ideas-2026-travel-budget): Budget-friendly March Break and spring break travel ideas for college students.
